<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    plus = []

    g = [n for n in seg if n['color']=='g']
    ring = None
    if g:
        r0 = min(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g); r1 = max(max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g)
